text: Scarb.TO - Scarborough. I looked into it.
Scarborough has a lot of stories hiding in its data.

Scarborough's maps and public records give me plenty to get curious about. I've brought the places, inspection results and neighbourhood boundaries together here, with their dates and sources. Pick a thread. Let's see where it leads.

Here's a favourite Scarborough map quirk: City wards and neighbourhoods don't always line up. Try either boundary to narrow the food inspection map and list. Beach samples and police division totals use different areas.

text: Let's turn local records into a neighbourhood update.

There's a lot tucked away in Scarborough's public records. Choose your patch and I'll bring the dated, source-linked findings together for print or your website. The evidence stays attached; you decide what to share.

A little map nerdiness before we begin: City neighbourhoods don't always stay inside Scarborough's six ward boundaries. For DineSafe, I count only records inside those wards, even if a selected neighbourhood carries on beyond them. These are editorial selections, not claimed newspaper or association territories.
